$comment: Evidence sidecar for candidate positions (see docs/candidate-scoring.md). Keyed candidateId -> parameterId -> { value, confidence, rationale, sources }. The engine does NOT read this file; candidates.json[value] is projected from here. WORK IN PROGRESS — golden sample only so far.

conflict.rationale: Chairs the Knesset caucus for a two-state solution and renewed negotiations; visited Ramallah in 2023 and argued Israel must choose dialogue with the PA over Hamas.

separation_annexation.rationale: Consistent two-state advocate opposed to annexation; explicit settlement-evacuation stance is implied by that framework rather than separately quoted.

economy.rationale: Labor MK active on social-justice and pensioners' lobbies; social-democratic profile, though not primarily an economic-policy figure.

religion_state.rationale: Reform rabbi and former CEO of the Reform Movement; authored a detailed framework for separating religious institutions from the state and fought Orthodox monopolies on conversion and marriage.

shared_society.rationale: Co-chaired the caucus advancing Jewish–Arab shared living; supports bilingual education and equal rights across communities.

positioning.rationale: Identifies clearly with the Zionist left and called for uniting leftist forces (Labor+Meretz); a values-left figure, not a center-tacker.

climate.rationale: Past Green Party affiliation but little current, signature environmental record; placed near the party prior.

experience.rationale: MK since 2021, chaired the Constitution Committee and now the Immigration & Diaspora Committee; former CEO of the Reform Movement (2009–2019).

flagship.rationale: Signature causes: freedom of religion and separation, Jewish–Arab shared society, civil liberties and free press, and constitutional/democratic safeguards.
